description: ABPA (Automatic Bike Path Analysis) - Beispieldaten is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Kernziel von ABPA (Automatic Bike Path Analysis) ist die Erforschung eines KI-basierten Monitorings der Beschaffenheit sowie des Zustandes von Radwegen. Neben der Analyse des Ist-Zustandes und der Definition des Soll-Zustandes der Datenlage werden prototypisch automatisierte, KI-basierte Verfahren zur Analyse der Befahrbarkeit von Wegen explorativ untersucht. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are hvd. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
